summary.text: Matthew Beger is the Democratic candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 41 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Doyle Justus and Libertarian Dalton Johnson.
A U.S. Marine Corps veteran, he owns an HVAC business.

paragraphs.text: Matthew Beger served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 2006 to 2010 and earned an associate degree from Vatterott College in 2011.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in St. Charles County, graduated from Francis Howell High School, was deployed to Iraq in 2007 and was honorably discharged in 2010.
He said he trained in HVAC and electrical work, joined Local 36 in 2016, finished his apprenticeship in 2022 and now owns Veterans HVAC with his wife.
Beger said he has lived in Lincoln County for ten years and that his campaign themes include accountability, decorum and empathy in politics.
